commands.title: Kernel and platform
commands.description: Show FreeBSD kernel, architecture, hostname, and build information.

commands.title: Uptime and load
commands.description: Show system uptime, logged-in users, and load averages.

commands.title: Interface configuration
commands.description: Show interface state, addressing, media, flags, and packet counters.

commands.title: Routing table
commands.description: Show IPv4 and IPv6 routes, gateways, flags, metrics, and interfaces.

commands.title: ARP table
commands.description: Show IPv4 neighbor cache entries, MAC addresses, and interfaces.

commands.title: Listening and connected sockets
commands.description: Show processes, users, descriptors, protocols, and local or remote endpoints.

commands.title: Packet filter status
commands.description: Show PF enabled state, counters, limits, state usage, and runtime statistics.

commands.title: Loaded filter rules
commands.description: Show detailed loaded filter rules, labels, evaluations, packets, and bytes.

commands.title: Loaded NAT rules
commands.description: Show active PF translation and redirection rules.

commands.title: Firewall state table
commands.description: Show active PF states and translated flow endpoints; output can expose internal traffic.

commands.title: PF table contents
commands.description: Show addresses currently loaded in one named PF alias table.

commands.title: Parsed firewall log
commands.description: Parse a bounded tail of firewall decisions into readable endpoint and rule data.

commands.title: Recent system log
commands.description: Read a bounded number of recent system log lines.

commands.title: Bounded packet capture
commands.description: Capture a bounded number of packet headers on one interface; payload and endpoint data are sensitive.

commands.title: Capture traffic for host
commands.description: Capture a bounded set of packets involving one host on one interface.

commands.title: Bounded ping
commands.description: Send a bounded set of ICMP echo probes from the firewall.

commands.title: Trace network path
commands.description: Trace layer-3 hops from the firewall toward a destination.

commands.title: DNS lookup
commands.description: Resolve a hostname using DNS from the firewall shell.

commands.title: Installed package audit
commands.description: Refresh vulnerability metadata and audit installed FreeBSD packages; requires repository access.

commands.title: Restart service through pfSense tools
commands.description: Restart one pfSense-managed service and potentially disrupt firewall functionality.
